estimates.t: • Credit losses on lease related receivables.

estimates.name: Acquisition of Real Estate Assets and Liabilities
estimates.t: The recorded allocations are based on estimated cash flow projections of the properties acquired which incorporates discount, capitalization and interest rates as well as available comparable market information.

estimates.name: Impairments of Real Estate Assets
estimates.t: We record impairments of our real estate assets classified as held for use when the carrying amount of the asset exceeds the sum of its undiscounted future operating and residual cash flows at the difference between estimated fair value of the asset and the carrying amount.

estimates.name: Credit Losses on Lease Related Receivables
estimates.t: Credit losses on lease related receivables, which include accounts receivable and accrued straight-line rents receivable, are recorded as a reduction to rental and other revenues when the amount recorded is determined, in management’s judgment, to not be probable of collection.
